record.paper_title: The puzzle of global Double Field Theory: open problems and the case for a Higher Kaluza-Klein perspective
record.original_question: Can Exceptional Field Theory be formulated as a Higher Kaluza-Klein theory on the total space of the twisted M2/M5-brane bundle gerbe over 11-dimensional super-spacetime?

evidence.quote: We are intrigued by the prospect that Exceptional Field Theory could be formalized as a Higher Kaluza-Klein Theory on the total space of the (twisted) M2/M5-brane bundle gerbe on the 11d super-spacetime, such as the one described by [FSS18a].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ denote 11-dimensional super-spacetime, modeled as the super-Minkowski supermanifold (or, more generally, a super-spacetime equipped with the structure required to support 11-dimensional supergravity). Over $X$ there exists a twisted bundle 2-gerbe (the "M2/M5-brane super 2-gerbe") whose underlying super L∞-cocycles are those classifying the M2-brane and M5-brane charges, namely the cocycles
$\mu_{M2} \in H^4(\mathfrak{m}\mathfrak{i}\mathfrak{n}\mathfrak{k}_{10,1|32};\mathbb{R})$ and $\mu_{M5} \in H^7(\mathfrak{m}\mathfrak{i}\mathfrak{n}\mathfrak{k}_{10,1|32};\mathbb{R})$ on 11-dimensional super-Minkowski; let $\mathcal{G} \to X$ denote the total space (in the sense of higher/principal ∞-bundles) of this twisted M2/M5 super 2-gerbe.

A "Higher Kaluza-Klein theory" on the total space of a smooth principal ∞-bundle $\pi:\mathcal{G}\to X$ is, by definition, a theory of an Ehresmann-type higher connection on $\mathcal{G}$ together with an invariant generalized metric on $\mathcal{G}$, whose dimensional reduction along the higher fibers reproduces, on the base $X$, both an ordinary metric and a tower of higher gauge fields with their associated charges and dualities.

Exceptional Field Theory (ExFT) is the U-duality-covariant reformulation of 11-dimensional supergravity in which the metric and the higher form fields ($C_3$, $C_6$, ...) of supergravity are unified into a single generalized geometric object on an "extended" or "exceptional" spacetime, with extra coordinates conjugate to M2- and M5-brane winding modes, subject to a section constraint that locally selects an 11-dimensional slice.

Problem. Prove or disprove the following: there exists a formulation of Exceptional Field Theory as a Higher Kaluza-Klein theory on the total space $\mathcal{G}$ of the twisted M2/M5-brane super 2-gerbe over 11-dimensional super-spacetime $X$, such that
(i) the generalized tangent geometry of ExFT on the exceptional extended space is naturally identified, fiberwise, with the higher tangent geometry of $\mathcal{G}\to X$;
(ii) the section constraint of ExFT corresponds to the higher Ehresmann horizontality condition on $\mathcal{G}$; and
(iii) the dimensional reduction along the higher fibers of $\mathcal{G}$ recovers 11-dimensional supergravity together with its M2- and M5-brane charges and U-duality structure on $X$.
artifact.category_tag: Higher gauge theory and exceptional field theory
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work has carried out this program partially. The Double Field Theory case (T-duality covariant) has been formulated as Higher Kaluza-Klein theory on the total space of the Kalb–Ramond bundle gerbe (Alfonsi, 2020). For the exceptional/U-duality case, the program of formulating Exceptional Field Theory as a higher Kaluza-Klein theory on the M2/M5 super 2-gerbe has been developed in subsequent works ("Extended Field Theories as higher Kaluza-Klein theories", 2021; "Towards an extended/higher correspondence", 2021), establishing the correspondence in significant cases but not yet a complete, fully global construction including all U-duality groups and full supergravity reduction. Hence the problem appears partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Global Double Field Theory is Higher Kaluza-Klein Theory
status_evidence.snippet: DFT is interpreted as a higher Kaluza-Klein theory set on the total space of a bundle gerbe underlying the Kalb-Ramond field.
status_evidence.claim: The DFT analogue of the conjecture is established.

status_evidence.title: Extended Field Theories as higher Kaluza-Klein theories
status_evidence.snippet: Extended Field Theories (DFT and ExFT) are interpreted as higher Kaluza-Klein theories on the total spaces of bundle gerbes/higher principal bundles.

status_evidence.title: Towards an extended/higher correspondence
status_evidence.snippet: Proposes a correspondence between extended geometry of ExFT and higher geometry on the M2/M5 super 2-gerbe.
status_evidence.claim: Develops the correspondence sought in the problem.
